channel.description: Latest articles from Our State Magazine (ourstate.com)

item.title: Cafeteria-Style Slaw | Our State
item.description: Make this retro, finely chopped slaw as a cooling accompaniment for blackened fish or barbecue.

item.title: Skillet-Fried Cod With Tartar Sauce | Our State
item.description: These seared, seasoned fish fillets cook in a snap, so make your sauce ahead of time to serve everything while it’s still hot.

item.title: 3 Old-School Cafeteria Recipes | Our State
item.description: Recipes for blackened fish, creamy slaw, and an egg custard pie help one chef reminisce on her days in the lunch line at North Carolina’s iconic K&W Cafeteria.

item.title: Old-Fashioned Green Beans & Potatoes With Fatback | Our State
item.description: Sheri Castle’s recipe for green beans and potatoes calls for double-cooking bits of fatback to turn it into meaty, crunchy croutons that gussy up the vegetables.

item.title: A Taste of Our State: Fatback | Our State
item.description: In the South, we happen upon fatback in our stores and well-seasoned sides. This month, fatback finds its way, finally, into Sheri Castle’s kitchen.

item.title: 6 Spots Shaking up Johnston County’s Craft Drink Scene | Our State
item.description: In Selma, Clayton, Benson, and Smithfield, NC, creative restaurateurs are using craft drinks to turn neighborhood bars and cafés into thoughtful community spots

item.title: Three Days of Spring Adventures in Jackson County | Our State
item.description: Warming weather and longer days make this season a beautiful time to embrace the outdoors with half-day hikes, captivating cascades, and meals to fuel each excursion.

item.title: Serving up Southern Comfort at PL8TE | Our State
item.description: PL8TE, Southern Table, a new eatery at Pinehurst Resort, reimagines beloved regional fare with a personal twist from Chef Michael Morris.

item.title: A Place to Grow at Wiregrass | Our State
item.description: A forthcoming Pinehurst restaurant takes inspiration from its surrounding landscape.

item.title: A New Spot to Savor in the Sandmines | Our State
item.description: At the edge of a golf course in Aberdeen, Station 21 serves up Southwestern flavors, plus a celebration of the surrounding location.
